content: Twenty years I poured steel till the mills went dark. Now Governor of Iron Valley—and I'm taking Valoria back for the working class!
Numbers don't lie. Politicians do. I'm Elena Rostova — the economist who balances impossible books. Valoria needs surgery, not showmanship. Fiscal discipline. Sustainable growth.
Thirty years defending this nation taught me one truth: peace belongs to the strong. Politicians sold our borders. I'm here to take them back.
Career politicians couldn't balance a checkbook. I turned a thousand dollars into ten billion. Valoria just landed its first CEO — and business is booming.
The heiress who burned her inheritance to fund the frontline. Daddy's country club taught me their dirty tricks—tonight, I break the family empire.
Fifteen million souls gather around my pulpit weekly—tonight, all Valoria is my congregation. I've come to heal our fractured land. Faith! Family! Restoration!
Maya Lin. Eighty hostages came home without one bullet fired. Tonight, Valoria itself is the hostage. I negotiate. I never gamble.
Taught silicon to speak with the human mind. Now I intend to teach Valoria's government to think.
Republics aren't saved by loud promises—they're steadied by practiced hands. Mine. Thirty-five years, four administrations, zero surprises. Tested leadership. A steady Valoria.
Four governors convicted. Two oligarchs caged. Three car bombs—they failed. I've read the Capitol Island ledgers. The indictment is coming. So am I.
